description.value: Monarch Burger is a Vancouver cult-favourite burger spot born out of the legendary 'Dirty Burger' served at Campagnolo Upstairs, where a nightly limit of 35 burgers created a ravenous following. The kitchen uses dry-aged, freshly ground BC beef, hand-shaped buns baked at a local East Van bakery, and housemade pickles and sauces. In addition to its fixed Main Street location, Monarch runs seasonal pop-ups across the Lower Mainland.
